I hear from Americans every day who are losing faith that our democracy works for them. It’s incumbent on all elected officials to end the chaos and corruption, and earn people’s trust. 

And beyond electeds, is time for all of us to act, to recognize the crisis for so many, and do more. No one is coming to save us. We are the heroes our country needs.

Video

1/3 of the time you feel great
1/3 of the time you feel okay
1/3 of the time you feel terrible

Here’s to those who choose to persevere anyway.

Who endure the hard days...
the messy, the difficult, the discouraging.

Who keep showing up,
good day or bad,
for themselves and for others.

Because greatness isn’t defined by how you feel, it’s defined by how you endure.

Thank you for your fight.

Robert Mueller was a dedicated and honorable public servant. He served his country in the Marines, as a federal prosecutor, and led the FBI at a critical time in our nation’s history.

Throughout his life, he demonstrated a commitment to the rule of law above partisanship and the relentless pursuit of justice.

I am lifting up his family and loved ones as they remember his legacy.

A valuable perspective from a master of story.

Robert McKee is a master story teller and his mission is both simple and profound:
ease the suffering of others,
and add to their well-being.

In a hurting world,
that is a worthy calling. 

From the great @richroll podcast.

Youth sports is now a $40 billion industry. It’s gotten out of control. 

As spring sports get underway, too many kids are sitting them out—not because they don't want to play, but because their families can't afford it. 

Youth sports should not be a luxury good.
